sprint.name: Feature Views - Part 1 (Agents, Hierarchy, Performance)
sprint.objective: Implement 3 feature views (Agents, Hierarchy, Performance) with real-time data integration, interactive controls, and full test coverage

acceptance_criteria.description: Agents view implemented with list/grid toggle, search, filters, and spawn/terminate controls
acceptance_criteria.verification: View renders agent list, search filters results, spawn modal works, terminate confirmation works

acceptance_criteria.description: Hierarchy view implemented with interactive tree visualization and export functionality
acceptance_criteria.verification: Tree renders from API, nodes expand/collapse, JSON/CSV export works

acceptance_criteria.description: Performance view implemented with charts, trends, and CSV export
acceptance_criteria.verification: Charts render with real data, time range selector works, CSV export includes all metrics

acceptance_criteria.description: All views have real-time WebSocket updates
acceptance_criteria.verification: Agent status changes update without refresh, metrics auto-update every 5s

acceptance_criteria.description: Test coverage ≥80% for all new view components
E2E tests pass for all 3 views with Playwright
acceptance_criteria.verification: npm run test:e2e passes all user flows

deliverables.name: Agents View Component
deliverables.description: Agent management view with list/grid display, search, filters (status, type, capabilities), spawn modal, terminate confirmation, real-time updates

deliverables.name: Hierarchy View Component
deliverables.description: Interactive hierarchy tree view with expand/collapse, node details panel, JSON/CSV export, real-time hierarchy updates

deliverables.name: Performance View Component
deliverables.description: Performance metrics dashboard with line/bar/gauge charts, time range selector (1h/6h/24h/7d/30d), trend analysis, CSV export

deliverables.name: Test Suites
deliverables.description: Unit tests (React Testing Library) and E2E tests (Playwright) for all 3 views

agents_view.layout: Grid container with filters sidebar (left 25%) and agent list/grid (right 75%)

features.search: Fuzzy search on agent name, ID, type, capabilities

actions.spawn: Modal with agent type selection, name input, capabilities multi-select
actions.terminate: Confirmation dialog with agent details and termination reason input
actions.view_details: Navigate to agent detail page (future sprint)

features.real_time: WebSocket subscription to 'agent:update' events, automatic list updates

agents_view.state_management: Zustand agentStore for agent list, filters, search term

hierarchy_view.layout: Full-width tree visualization with node details panel (right drawer, 30% width)

features.tree_visualization: AgentHierarchyTreeContainer with expand/collapse, depth indicators, parent-child lines
features.node_interaction: Click to view details, double-click to expand/collapse subtree
features.details_panel: Agent info, children list, parent link, metadata (tasks_completed, confidence, spawned_at)

export.json: Complete hierarchy structure with all metadata
export.csv: Flat list with depth, parent_id, all agent fields

features.real_time: WebSocket subscription to 'hierarchy:change' events, tree updates on agent spawn/terminate

hierarchy_view.state_management: Zustand agentStore for hierarchy data, selected node

performance_view.layout: Grid with key metrics cards (top), charts row 1 (CPU/Memory), charts row 2 (Agents/Events), controls (time range selector, export)

charts.cpu_chart: Line chart with time series, dual-axis (percent, cores)
charts.memory_chart: Line chart with used/total, stacked area
charts.events_chart: Line chart with event types breakdown

features.export_csv: All metrics for selected time range with timestamps

performance_view.state_management: Zustand metricsStore for performance data, time range

loop3_agents.focus: Implement 3 view components with Material-UI, real-time updates, interactive controls
Design Zustand store updates, WebSocket subscriptions, data flow for 3 views
Create unit tests (React Testing Library) and E2E tests (Playwright) for all views

loop2_validators.focus: Architecture review, acceptance criteria validation, code quality
Code quality analysis, test coverage verification, performance assessment

risks.risk: WebSocket connection reliability during rapid agent spawn/terminate
risks.mitigation: Use connection pooling, message queue, exponential backoff (already in WebSocketClient from Sprint 1.3)
Virtual scrolling in AgentHierarchyTree, lazy loading of subtrees, debounce expand/collapse

risks.risk: Chart rendering performance with 30d time range (720 data points)
risks.mitigation: Data aggregation on backend, limit client-side points to 200 with sampling

success_metrics.functionality: All 6 acceptance criteria met (3 views implemented, real-time updates, test coverage ≥80%)
success_metrics.performance: View load time <2s, chart render time <500ms, WebSocket latency <100ms
success_metrics.quality: Loop 2 consensus ≥0.90, TypeScript strict mode, ESLint clean
success_metrics.testing: 90 tests passing (60 unit, 30 E2E), coverage ≥80% lines/functions/branches/statements

estimated_effort.integration: 4 hours (WebSocket subscriptions, API integration, state updates)
estimated_effort.total: 42 hours (~5-6 days with CFN Loop iterations)
